notes.title: Act 2 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everybody! Goba here.



We are coming up on the one year anniversary of release. How harrowing!



That being said, great progress has been made on Act 2, and I'd like to share some of it with you. The first dungeon of Act 2 is nearing completion, sporting a beautiful new visual style. As well, the new cutscenes are looking better than ever. Take a look!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/e80704cf24a074dfffae4c5b1b211a127079c5c5.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/a9f5d766c425e3dad29c94325de6e8cc7d35932d.gif"]


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/55376f4b2b7c4a92a3fa4df64c4416fd124887a8.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/9aa3d6fc090a016a7087b8c6e3cc7986abc75257.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/df3bfef3a556ad3ff7d360367a583af2de66f222.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/5b970df0e90a98159da141866c120937ef694a26.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/b1b771edfd39b4cc8747ce462569550a8446fc9e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/384a2154b27e730846963551a6b210e8abbaaa27.png"][/carousel]
The Temple of the Lost Faith is the first dungeon of Act 2: an ancient, pre-Phyllubian religious site taken over by Helix operatives. It is your first stop on the way to Iridopolis, the Elven capital. The dungeon is gorgeous, with secrets to find and new enemies to encounter. I'm confident you'll love it!



I am hoping to share more in the coming months. Thank you all for your patience! I do not yet have a concrete release date, but if I had to put a percentage on it, I would say Act 2 is roughly 30% complete.

notes.title: Winter Content Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! I hope the holidays have treated you well! If you've been following me on my social media, you'll have noticed I've been working on a new content update. It was intended for Christmas day, but unfortunately-timed illness pushed it back a few days. Oh, the horror!

This update comes bearing two decent gifts! Two mini-dungeons, in fact!

A mysterious artist has appeared in Kaliere Commune! His work has the ability to transport you to another world... literally!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/e2d14aa58aa687f2bf2026433019d5109d2b78af.png

You can find him in the now-appropriately labeled Arts building in the middle of the market. Speak with him to begin the new Constructive Criticism quest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/5c6b4d0b2e872df7536a43fab19bb7554c0f187e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/7085c132aafd290a9d4398cfcf5e422c4eb84934.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/9e004c876c3f26abac9758c00fb7d54bfa0fd0ee.png

Rewards for completing this mini-dungeon are meaty! A whole new weapon paired with a whole new costume! How's that for a Christmas gift?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/802b412b75a45bf8888ec39445e3fdb8dfde7797.png

Alongside that, the basement of the Observatory has been opened! A wizard has gone missing in that musty old place... Surely nothing weird is afoot!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/f2cc6c029dbca5484eaace2c75337c5e61592ef2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056549/57498747c02ad16a38e4ae90e54324b80c2366f8.png

Along with the new content additions, this update lands a few fixes and changes to existing systems.

Thank you all for the support, and onward to Act 2! Happy holidays and to an even happier new year! Yippee!!

Full changelog:


 Air combos now properly increment the internal air combo counter, so infinite aerial spam is less possible
 Carter disappearing in certain cutscenes and the associated softlocks are now fixed beyond a reasonable doubt (This fix seems to appear in every patch, but mark my words this is the one!!)
 Added the Constructive Criticism quest
 Added the Magic Paint Brush weapon
 Added the Artist costume
 Added a generalized "revenge" system for enemies, to avoid infinite combos. No Act 1 enemies have been changed, but expect future enemies to take advantage of this.
 Fixed a hardlock in the Frogon Fighting minigame
